description: Belgium KBO/BCE Company Scraper - Directors & VAT. Scrape Belgium's KBO/BCE registry from the official public search: company identity, status, legal form, address, NACEBEL activity codes and NAMED directors/managers. Lookup by enterprise/VAT number or company name. No API key. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

activeOnly.description: When searching by name, return only active (non-ceased) entities. Ignored in byNumber mode.
activeOnly.title: Active entities only (name search)

enterpriseNumbers.description: Belgian enterprise numbers or VAT numbers to look up (used when searchMode = byNumber). Any common format works: "0417.497.106", "0417497106" or "BE0417497106".
enterpriseNumbers.title: Enterprise / VAT numbers

includeFormerNames.description: When no current name matches, search again including former company names (e.g. a company renamed since). Companies found only this way carry matchedFormerName: true. Works with Closest names only. Ignored in byNumber mode.
includeFormerNames.title: Search former names (name search)

language.description: Language of the registry labels/descriptions (NACEBEL activity descriptions, status text). The data itself is identical across languages.
language.title: Output language

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of company records to extract. 0 means no limit. Useful to cap broad name searches.
maxResults.title: Max results

minIntervalMs.description: Polite delay between requests to the registry. Lower is faster but less courteous; 400ms is a safe default.
minIntervalMs.title: Min interval between requests (ms)

nameFilter.description: Read up to 5 result pages (100 entities) and extract only the companies whose name is closest to the search term, instead of every entity on the first page. Fewer records, and the exact name is not lost among many similar ones. Extracts at most 25 records unless Max results is set. Ignored in byNumber mode.
nameFilter.title: Closest names only (name search)

searchMode.description: How to look up companies. "byNumber" fetches exact companies by enterprise/VAT number (most precise, ideal for KYC/KYB enrichment). "byName" runs the official phonetic name search and then fetches each match.
searchMode.title: Search mode

searchQuery.description: Company name to search for (used when searchMode = byName). Uses the registry's phonetic search, so minor spelling differences still match. Add a place or another word of the name to narrow very common names. A legal form at the start or end (BV, NV, SRL, SA, VZW ...) is left out automatically: registered names rarely carry it, and the registry finds nothing when the search term has one.
searchQuery.title: Company name

name: regdata_belgium_kbo_company
